paragraphs.text: Hugo, Aurora, and BFA-winning editor Elsa Sjunneson is a deafblind writer from Seattle, USA.

Her nonfiction editorial work has appeared in Uncanny Magazine and Fireside Magazine . As an author, her work has appeared at CNN Opinion, Tor.com, the Boston Globe, and the Nebula-nominated Fate Accessibility Toolkit among numerous other venues. In addition to editorial and authorial pursuits, she educates authors on writing disability respectfully.
Elsa Sjunneson contributed to the Magic Story for Kaldheim .
